basic_profile.bio: Passionate cyclist based in Portland, Oregon. I've been biking since my college days and have a particular affinity for road biking. I work as a software developer, so my online hours are usually in the evenings or during weekends. I'm currently single and spend a lot of my free time exploring biking trails or tinkering with my bike. I'm not a fan of overly technical jargon but appreciate practical advice and recommendations.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Computer Science and have been working in the tech industry for over a decade. My interest in biking started as a hobby, and over the years, I've learned a lot from online communities and personal experience. I enjoy staying updated with the latest gear and tech innovations in cycling.
